scope: source-only narrow review of two fixture repairs, complete exact diff and changed tests plus actual open_at wrapper; no Rust compile or execution

findings.assessment: The new native openat and production wrapper use the same held old proc-dir, ns/mnt path, and O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC flags after the exact owned child is reaped and pin.live confirms death. Raw errno is captured immediately. Unexpected raw success is closed before failing. Only ENOENT/ESRCH are accepted and the wrapper must exactly preserve that actual errno plus role/name/base identity; no replacement PID lookup or successful revival is accepted.

The invalid faulted-and-complete audit is still required to fail encoding. Only that fixture then sets incomplete before constructing the wire. The status, real old send-first rejection, exact owned exit, audit/status equality, retire publication and repeated-call checks remain in place. This does not change the production codec, retirement authority or poison behavior.

limitations: No local Rust toolchain or Rust test execution was used in this review.
The kernel errno oracle is a sequential native syscall comparison on a held dead-process directory, not a simultaneous kernel observation. The actual matching test run remains required.
Retirement completed for an explicitly faulted receipt is not evidence that the workload or NORMAL lifecycle was healthy.
The prior actual ordinary13 two test failures and prior peer scope remain unchanged.
